issues.description: Function build_msd_circ: the problem statement declares the parameter y_states with type tuple[int], while both the template and the reference solution declare y_states with type list[int]. This mismatch between the documented signature (problem_statement.md) and the actual code (template and solution) can confuse students about whether to supply a tuple or a list (or whether either is acceptable). The discrepancy appears in the problem description's function signature and the def lines in both msd.py files.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of the y_states parameter consistent across the artifacts. Either: (a) update problem_statement.md to declare y_states: list[int] to match the template and solution; or (b) change the template and solution signatures to y_states: tuple[int]; or (c) document and accept a more general type such as Iterable[int] in the spec and in code docstrings so students know both lists and tuples are acceptable.
